subject: Saving dataset without duplicate markers info

messages.author: 87af66513dd507f5
messages.subject: Saving dataset without duplicate markers info
parts:
Can anyone help me please in figuring out how to save the dataset without the duplicate marker. I loaded my dataset (fv.csv) and used following codes:

fv<- read.cross("csvr", "filepath", "fv.csv")
dupmar <- findDupMarkers(fv, exact.only = T) 
fv.nodup <- drop.markers(fv, unlist(dupmar))


I understand that unlist(dupmar) will remove the duplicate markers and new vector (fv.nodup) won't have those markers. However can I create a dataset file (just like fv.csv) with no duplicate marker's information and save it to my computer?

Thanks in advance,
Prashant

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] Saving dataset without duplicate markers info
parts:
Use write.cross()

    write.cross(fv.nodup, “csvr”, “filepath/fv_nodup”)

karl
